QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Up the Ladder
QuestInfo.0: You have delivered all the spoils of war that Isaac requested. Can you enter the village now? Talk to Isaac and find out.
QuestInfo.1: Blundell, general of Kritias's army, wants to see you. Find him at the #bNorthern Barracks#k.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Blundell, the nicest general in Kritias.

0.1: The general's heard about you. He wants to see you in person.\r\n#L0##bYour commander?#l\n#k
0.2: Yup. None other then General Blundell, leader of the Kritias Army. He should be hanging 'round the #bNorthern Barracks#k.

yes.0: There's no time to waste! Mosey through the Forest of Sorrows quick as you can. The #bNorthern Barracks#k are thereabouts.

no.0: You gotta get your head screwed on straight! Meeting General Blundell could make your career, soldier! ...Hold on. You ain't one of my men, are you? I keep forgetting...

yes.0: I am General Blundell, but you can just call me buddy. I'm in charge of keeping the baddies out of Kritias.

npc.0: Ol' General Blundell's in the #bNorthern Barracks#k. Just head left, through the Forest of Sorrows.
